Glycolysis is defined as the metabolic pathway that breaks down glucose into pyruvate (under aerobic conditions) or lactate (under anaerobic conditions). It does not directly produce acetyl CoA — that occurs in the pyruvate dehydrogenase reaction after glycolysis. Glycogen breakdown to glucose-1-phosphate is part of glycogenolysis, not glycolysis.  

The correct description is the conversion of glucose (or glycogen via glucose) to pyruvate or lactate.  

Final answer: (C)
